cars.specification_market: French road-car brochure specification dated September 1, 1974 in its printed footer. Uses the 1294 cc technical panel: 84 ch DIN, not the narrative panel’s conflicting 83 cv wording. Native torque units are retained. Standard/optional trim and alloy-wheel statements are not generalized. No road performance, weight, production total, corrosion-protection guarantee, U8 prototype or competition-engine data is imported. All original Bagheera phases, engine choices and later Simca/Talbot badge versions belong to this one family.
cars.summary: The Bagheera made Matra’s transverse mid-engine sports-car layout work with three seats across a single front row. Its glass-fibre-reinforced polyester panels, self-supporting steel structure, independent suspension and four assisted disc brakes give that unusual packaging a substantive sporting basis. It represents a distinctive French sports-car design programme, not merely a rare trim. One original Bagheera family is counted; later engines, facelifts, Courreges trim and Talbot badging add no extra entries.

One original Bagheera family is counted; later engines, facelifts, Courreges trim and Talbot badging add no extra entries.

cars.variant: 2.2 five-speed — French model-year 1981 brochure, edition July 15, 1980
cars.specification_market: French model-year 1981 Talbot-Matra road brochure, printed edition July 15, 1980, reference 1 E 011. Selects the ordinary 2.2 column, not 1.6, kit 142 or S. The table distinguishes ISO kW from DIN ch; only native DIN power and torque are retained without silently converting the unlike standards. Some consumption entries are still marked undergoing homologation; no performance, consumption, production count, universal world-first claim or current warranty entitlement is imported. Other original Murena engines, years, tuning kits and trim add no counts.
cars.summary: The Murena developed Matra’s three-abreast mid-engine sports-coupe idea into a distinct successor with a five-speed transmission and a hot-dip galvanised structure. Its combination of unconventional passenger packaging, independent suspension, disc brakes and an innovative corrosion-protection process gives it lasting engineering significance within French sports-car history. One original Murena family is admitted; the 1.6, tuned 2.2, kit 142 and S versions do not create extra counts.

facts.explanation: The Murena developed Matra’s three-abreast mid-engine sports-coupe idea into a distinct successor with a five-speed transmission and a hot-dip galvanised structure. Its combination of unconventional passenger packaging, independent suspension, disc brakes and an innovative corrosion-protection process gives it lasting engineering significance within French sports-car history. One original Murena family is admitted; the 1.6, tuned 2.2, kit 142 and S versions do not create extra counts.
